author: V.M. Sawh
title: Indie Author seeking experienced character artists for 2027 dark fantasy book
content:
Attn Artists:

I'm an Indie Author looking for experienced character artists for an exciting 2027 dark fantasy book with 10+ full page colour illustrations in a 6x9" hardcover interior.

Artists, please link your portfolios.

Criteria:
1) NO AI. Real artists only
2) Your portfolio must include at least one Creature/Werewolf/Demon and one Beautiful Woman to be considered
3) Semi/Realistic Illustrations (colour and B&W)
4) Canadian Artists preferred
5) Vibe Check: https://pin.it/15teNuksT

Contact via replies on the post.
